description_en: Sets the quota for a workspace
kebab_example: aliyun dms set-workspace-quota --workspace-id 20923000007291 --cu-quota 200 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --auto-pay false --client-token acdxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetWorkspaceQuota

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Data Management Service (DMS) workspace
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The compute unit (CU) quota for the workspace
parameters.name: cu_quota

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-payment for the order
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: A unique, client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no longer than 64 characters. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token
